pages.text: SYN Business Review compares fund performance over the past year. Trading volumes were broadly in line with the previous month, according to exchange data. Officials declined to comment on whether further changes were planned. The Swala Equity Fund charged 2.4 percent a year, with a minimum of SYN Sh 500. The Kiboko Bond Fund charged 2.2 percent a year, with a minimum of SYN Sh 5,000.

The Baraka Money Market Fund charged 2.4 percent a year, with a minimum of SYN Sh 1,000. The Mto Bond Fund charged 1.8 percent a year, with a minimum of SYN Sh 5,000. The Zuri Balanced Fund charged 2.0 percent a year, with a minimum of SYN Sh 10,000. The Kiboko Balanced Fund charged 2.4 percent a year, with a minimum of SYN Sh 500.
